PlaylistDocument.title: PlaylistDocument
PlaylistDocument.description: A cloud-synced music playlist with artwork, title, metadata, and serialized tracklist.

subtitle.description: Subtitle such as track count or curator

previewArtworks.description: Up to 4 song artwork URLs for mosaic cover rendering

songCount.description: Number of songs in the playlist

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the playlist owner

ownerName.description: Display name of the playlist owner

isPublic.description: Whether the playlist is publicly readable by authenticated users

songsJson.description: Serialized JSON array of tracks in the playlist

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when playlist was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when playlist was last updated

/playlists/{playlistId}.description: Cloud-synced playlists created or imported by users
